name: Pawmot
description: Pawmot, the Hands-On Pokémon, and the evolved form of Pawmo. An Electric and Fighting type.
pokedex_entries: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.
Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.
